thread.title: Senator Rick Scott introduces bill to restrict Chinese tech companies in U.S. markets
thread.title_full: Senator Rick Scott introduces bill to restrict Chinese tech companies in U.S. markets

author: Sunshine Sentinel
title: Senator Rick Scott introduces bill to restrict Chinese tech companies in U.S. markets
text:
Senator Rick Scott and Senator Tom Cotton introduced the Blocking CCP Spy Tech Act of 2026 on May 20, a bill that would require national security officials to assess whether certain Chinese technology firms pose a threat to U.S. national security.
The proposed legislation targets six technology companies from Hangzhou, China—DeepSeek, Game Science, Unitree Robotics, DEEP Robotics, BrainCo, and Manycore Tech—known as the “Six Little Dragons.” These firms are seen as leaders in artificial intelligence, robotics, and digital industries linked to the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). The bill aims to address concerns about foreign access to American markets and data.
Recent reports indicate that Unitree Robotics integrated an undocumented remote access tunnel called “CloudSail” into its products, which connects devices to servers based in China. BrainCo has reportedly collected brainwave data from American schoolchildren during a trial at a Boston school in 2019. Additionally, BrainCo’s technology is said to be used within Unitree’s humanoid robots and has been involved with universities identified by the U.S. as closely tied to China’s defense sector.
If passed, the bill would give federal authorities one year to investigate these companies’ products or services for potential threats. Any equipment or service found risky could be added to the Federal Communications Commission’s Covered List of dangerous communications technologies.
Scott said: “Communist China is not our friend. They have chosen to be our enemies and want to destroy us. That’s why it’s imperative that we ensure that any company or entity connected with the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) and CCP are not given unfettered access to the U.S. economy. By prohibiting Communist Chinese companies from accessing American markets, U.S. manufacturing will get a fairer playing field to create family-sustaining jobs. We can’t let China steal from us without accountability, and this bill makes sure China can’t keep taking advantage of hardworking Americans.”
Cotton said: “Chinese technology threatens Americans’ privacy and national security. Our bill would ban any Chinese technology that poses an unacceptable risk to security and safety from being sold in the United States.”
Scott serves on several Senate committees including Armed Services; Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs; Budget; and Aging according to his official website . He won election as Florida’s senator after serving on active duty in the Navy aboard USS Glover following high school graduation according to his official website .
